pages.ja: その異状に気がついたのは、どれほどの時が経ってからか。
pages.jaRuby: その異状に気がついたのは、どれほどの時が経ってからか。
pages.en: How much time passed before she noticed the disturbance?
pages.mirrorMoon: How long has it taken her to notice that something is wrong?

pages.ja:
眠りの中、蜘蛛の糸ほどの違和感に目を覚まして、彼女は廊下へと足を運ぶ。
「………シロウ？」
始め、それは彼女の主による物だと考えた。
異状は衛宮士郎の部屋から、外に放たれた物であったからだ。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
Deep in sleep, she wakes to an unease as faint as a strand of spider silk and steps into the corridor.

“…Shirou?”

At first, she assumes that her Master is responsible.

After all, the disturbance appears to be emanating from Shirou Emiya's room.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She wakes up to a strange feeling and goes out into the hallway.
“……Shirou?”
She first thinks that the feeling might be coming from her master.
It is because the strange feeling is coming from Emiya Shirou’s room.

pages.ja:
「……まったく。まだ魔術の鍛錬をしているのですか」
ふう、と金の髪の少女
セイバーは溜息をつく。
熱心なのはいいが、休む時には休んで貰わなければ体が保つまい。
そうして注意しに行こうと足を向けた時、彼女は自らの過ちに気がついた。

pages.en:
“…Honestly. Is he still practicing his magecraft?”

The golden-haired girl—Saber—lets out a sigh.

His dedication is admirable, but unless he rests when rest is called for, his body cannot possibly endure.

She turns to admonish him, and only then realizes her mistake.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Geez. Is he still training magic?”
The golden-haired girl
Saber sighs.
It’s good that he’s enthusiastic, but he will collapse unless he rests while he can.
And when she decides to go warn him, she realizes her own mistake.

pages.ja:
「
」
それを確かめて、彼女は息を呑んだ。
異状は士郎の部屋から放たれた物ではない。
月光の下。
彼女の髪と同じく、闇に輝く細い糸が張られている。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“————”

She confirms what she sensed and draws a sharp breath.

The disturbance is not flowing outward from Shirou's room.

Beneath the moonlight, a slender thread gleams in the darkness like a strand of her own hair.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
She gasps after confirming it.
The strange feeling isn’t coming from Shirou’s room.
Under the moonlight…
A string, thin as her hair, runs through the darkness.

pages.ja:
ただ一本のみの糸は屋敷の外から、士郎の部屋へと放たれたものだった。
屋敷に張られた結界でさえ見逃すほどの細い糸。
pages.jaRuby:
ただ一本のみの糸は屋敷の外から、士郎の部屋へと放たれたものだった。
屋敷に張られた結界でさえ見逃すほどの細い糸。
pages.en:
There is only one.

It reaches from somewhere beyond the estate and into Shirou's room.

The thread is so fine that even the bounded field surrounding the house failed to detect it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The string is going into Shirou’s room from outside.
A thin string that even the boundary field here did not catch.
If one is to give praise to the one who pulled off such a thing, one also needs to give praise to Saber for noticing such a thing.

」
思考の余地などない。
少女の姿は一瞬にして騎士の姿となり、即座に外へと飛び出した。

“————”

There is no time for thought.

In an instant, the girl becomes a knight and bursts out of the house.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
There’s no time to think.
The girl turns into a knight in an instant and runs outside.

pages.ja:
無人の町を駆ける。
地を蹴るセイバーに迷いはない。
行くべき場所は判っている。
この糸が続く先、士郎の鼓動を追うだけでいい。
彼女がするべき事は、ただ最速で駆けつけるのみ。
その先が敵地であり、顎の如く罠が張り巡らされた死地であっても変わりはない。
主を守ると誓ったのだ。
ならば己が身にかかる火の粉など、顧みるにも値しまい。

pages.en:
She races through the deserted town.

There is no hesitation in the feet driving her across the ground.

She knows where she must go.

She need only follow the thread to its end—to the heartbeat of Shirou, her master.

Her sole duty is to reach him with all possible speed.

It matters nothing if enemy ground awaits her, a killing field bristling with traps like the maw of some waiting beast.

She swore to protect her Master.

Any danger that might fall upon her is beneath consideration.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She runs through the empty town.
There’s no hesitation in Saber as she runs.
She knows where she must go.
She only needs to follow the string, the beat of her master.
The only thing she has to do is to run as fast as she can.
It makes no difference whether her destination is the enemy’s territory nor how many traps might await her.
She has sworn to protect her master.
So anything that might befall her is negligible.

pages.ja:
「
」
そこは、夥しい魔力に汚染された山だった。
上空には死霊が鴉の様に旋回し、
木々に育った葉は視えない血に濡れている。
集められた魔力、剥離された精神が残留し、山は禿げ山の如く訪れたモノを食らうだろう。
世に死地があるというのなら、ここは紛れもなく最低の極上品。

」

pages.en:
“————”

The mountain before her is steeped in a monstrous quantity of magical energy.

Dead spirits wheel overhead like crows.

The leaves upon the trees are drenched in invisible blood.

Harvested magical energy and flayed-away minds linger in the air, and the mountain stands like some ravenous wasteland, ready to devour whatever enters.

If the world contains such a thing as a killing ground, this is surely the finest specimen of the very worst.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
It is a mountain stained with vast amounts of magical energy.
Ghosts of the dead are flying above like crows,
and the trees are covered with invisible blood.
The collected magical energy, the stolen souls, remains here, and the mountain should consume anyone that may approach it.
If there is such a thing as a place to die, this place is a perfect example.

pages.ja:
「
」
それに、躊躇する事なく踏み込んだ。
もとより止まる意思などない。
この場所が地獄であるのならば、尚のこと己が主を救わねばならないのだから。
石の階段を駆け上がる。
予想されていた妨害はまったくない。
山門は既に視界に収まっており、あと一段、魔力を籠めた足で石段を蹴り抜けば山門に達しよう。
「
」
だが、そこで彼女の進撃は止まった。
否
その“敵”に、止められた。

pages.en:
“————”

She steps into it without hesitation.

She never had any intention of stopping.

If this place is hell, then all the more reason to rescue her Master from it.

She flies up the stone steps.

None of the resistance she expected appears.

The gate is already in sight. One last kick against the stone with magical energy behind it, and she will reach the gate.

“————”

But there her advance comes to an end.

No—that enemy brings it to an end.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
She goes in without hesitation.
She had no intention to stop from the start.
If this place is hell, she has to save her master all the more.
She runs up the stone stairs.
The traps she had anticipated are not there.
The mountain gate is within her view, and she should reach it with one more kick from her magical energy-filled legs.
“
”
But her advance stops right there.
No
it is stopped by the “enemy”.

pages.ja:
山門に至る階段。
そこに一人のサーヴァントが立っていた。
名を佐々木小次郎。
アサシンのサーヴァント、長刀物干し竿を操る、柳洞寺の守り手である。
pages.jaRuby:

名を佐々木小次郎。
アサシンのサーヴァント、長刀物干し竿を操る、柳洞寺の守り手である。
pages.en:
Upon the steps leading to the temple gate stands a single Servant.

His name is Sasaki Kojirou.

The Servant Assassin, wielder of the long sword Monohoshizao, and guardian of Ryuudou Temple.
pages.mirrorMoon:
On the stairs leading to the mountain gate…
Stands a Servant.
His name is Sasaki Kojirou.
Servant Assassin, the protector of the Ryuudou Temple, wielding the longsword Monohoshizao.

pages.ja:
「
」
風王結界を構えるセイバーの心境は、ここにきて乱れていた。
彼女のマスターはあの山門の向こうにいる。
だが目の前に立ちはだかるサーヴァントは、あまりにも正体が不明だった。
惜しげもなく名を明かす心胆。
構えなどなく、涼やかな敵意はあまりに透明。

pages.en:
“————”

Saber readies Invisible Air, but for the first time since arriving, her composure begins to waver.

Her Master lies beyond that gate.

Yet the Servant barring her way remains utterly inscrutable.

He revealed his name without a trace of concern.

He assumes no stance, and the cool hostility he gives off is almost perfectly transparent.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
Saber’s mind is disturbed as she readies her “Invisible Air”.
Her Master is on the other side of that mountain gate.
But the Servant in front of her is way too strange.
He reveals his true name willingly.
He does not have a stance, and his cool enmity is transparent.

pages.ja:
「
」
その、逸脱した無心に力量が掴めない。
サーヴァントとして相手の格は見抜けてはいる。
アサシンはそう優れたサーヴァントではない。ならば御しやすいと下す反面、彼女の直感が告げているのだ。
剣の勝負
単純な剣の試合では、この相手には勝ちえないと。

pages.en:
“————”

His unnatural emptiness leaves her unable to gauge his strength.

She can discern his general rank as a Servant. Assassin is not an especially powerful one; by that measure alone, he should be easy to handle.

Yet her instincts tell her otherwise.

In a contest of swords—a simple duel and nothing more—she cannot defeat this opponent.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
She cannot figure out his power because of his transparency.
She can see his power as a Servant.
Assassin is not a strong Servant, so it should be easy to defeat him. But her instincts are telling her something different…
That she cannot beat him in a normal duel.

pages.ja:
「
貴様に用はない。そこを退けアサシン」
正体の掴めない不安を押し留め、セイバーはアサシンを睨む。
……一足一刀の間合いまで石段一つ。
下りるか上るか。
どちらかが足を踏み出せば、その瞬間に必殺の剣が繰り出されるに違いない。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“I have no business with you. Stand aside, Assassin.”

Saber suppresses her unease at the mystery before her and fixes Assassin with a glare.

…One stone step separates them from the distance where a single stride brings a killing stroke.

Down or up.

The instant either of them moves, a fatal blade will surely follow.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
I do not have any business with you. Move, Assassin.”
She suppresses the strange unease and glares at Assassin.
There’s only one more step until they are both within range.
Up or down.
If either one moves, a fatal attack should be executed.

pages.ja:
「聞こえなかったのか。退けと言ったのだ、アサシン」
最後の問答。
それを、長刀の剣士は愉しげに受け止める。
「
そうか。この門を通りたいのだな、セイバー」
「
」
愚問、と聖緑の瞳がアサシンを射抜く。
それを良しとしたのか。
長刀は、弧を描くように夜に跳ねる。
「ならば押し通れ。急がねば、おまえの主人とやらの命はないぞ」
涼しげに笑う声。
「アサシン
！」
応と言わんばかりに石段に踏み込むセイバー。
同時に振り下ろされる長刀は、彼女の不可視の剣によって弾かれる。

pages.en:
“Did you not hear me? I told you to stand aside, Assassin.”

Her final warning.

The swordsman with the long blade receives it with evident pleasure.

“Ah. So you wish to pass through this gate, Saber.”

“————”

Her sacred green eyes pierce him with the answer: what a foolish question.

Perhaps that satisfies him.

The long sword springs into the night, tracing an arc.

“Then force your way through. If you do not hurry, this master of yours will lose his life.”

His voice carries a cool smile.

“Assassin——!”

Saber charges onto the steps as though accepting his challenge.

The long blade falls at the same instant and is thrown back by her invisible sword.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Did you not hear me? I told you to move, Assassin.”
Her final warning.
The swordsman with a longsword calmly responds to her words.
“
I see. So you would like to pass this mountain gate, Saber?”
“
”
Her green eyes glare at Assassin for asking such a foolish question.
He must like the answer.
The longsword dances through the night in an arc.
“Then force your way through. You should hurry, or your master’s life will be gone.”
He laughs in a cool manner.
“Assassin
!”
Saber charges in reply.
The longsword comes down at her at the same moment, and she repels it with her invisible sword.

繰り広げられる攻防は互角。
だが、それは彼女にとって有利という訳ではない。
「くっ
」
気が焦る。
すぐさま倒さねばならない敵は、その実倒すこと自体が困難な難敵である。

pages.en:
Upon the windswept summit, the sparks of clashing swords echo through the night.

The battle unfolding between them is even.

But an even battle offers her no advantage.

“Kh——”

Impatience gnaws at her.

She must defeat this enemy at once, yet defeating him at all will be no simple feat.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The clash of the swords echoes through the summit.
Their powers are equal.
But that is not an advantage for her.
“Kuh
”
She’s impatient.
The enemy she must quickly defeat is a strong one that would be hard to beat even without any time constraints.

pages.ja:
“シロウ、どうか
！”
歯をかみ殺しながら懸命に祈る。
その隙、その余分こそが彼女の体を浸食していく。
決着はつかず。
山門に至る道は、あまりにも遠かった。
pages.jaRuby:

山門に至る道は、あまりにも遠かった。
pages.en:
*Shirou, please——!*

She grinds her teeth and prays with all her strength.

That distraction, that small division of her mind, is precisely what begins to eat away at her body.

The battle remains unresolved.

The road to the temple gate has never seemed so impossibly long.
pages.mirrorMoon:
‘Shirou, please
!’
She grits her teeth and prays.
That opening, that excess part of her, is permeating her body.
The battle does not end.
The mountain gate is too far away.
